messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED - multiple customers seeing increased 5xx and incorrect completions. Possible KV/prefix cache mismatch detected. Pager: @sarah oncall. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cache-mismatch. Please ack and start triage. :rotating_light:

sarah: acked. jumping in. seeing spike in `runtime.log` for model 'redwood-open-7b' with errors like `kv: checksum mismatch for prefix 'user:'` and a bunch of `500` downstream. Count: ~2.8k errors in the last 5m.

eli: oncall second, here. I looked at metrics — hot prefixes causing cache thrash. Some tenants are hammering long-prefix queries which overflow the prefix-KV mapping and trigger fallback that returns stale or null responses. I've pushed a temporary flag to bypass prefix cache for the model variant in the canary pool.

deploy-bot: CONFIG UPDATE applied by eli: `service/runtime:set --model redwood-open-7b --env prod --kv-prefix-cache=disabled --reason "mitigation: cache mismatch"`

mike: +1. Recommend immediate traffic shaping: set tenant-level rate limit for the top offending tenants and drop long-tail polling. Proposal: `rate-limiter:update --tenant acme-inc --limit 10r/s` and `rate-limiter:update --tenant beta-shop --limit 5r/s`. Also enable quota fallback: `quotas:set --tenant acme-inc --burst 20 --window 60s` to avoid stampede.

sarah: doing that now. Running commands:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/rl/update -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${RL_TOKEN}' -d '{"tenant":"acme-inc","limit":10}'
```
Applied to live within 30s. Monitoring.

jordan: product/CS chiming in — ACME reported wrong completions in 3 customer-reported sessions. We need to DM them asap and flag for rollback if we see persistent bad outputs. Do we have a list of affected request ids?

eli: grabbing logs. Found sample request ids: `rq_8f3a2`, `rq_8f3b9`, `rq_8f4d1` that returned truncated responses when the cache fallback path was hit. I'm taking a snapshot of current KV state for debugging: `kvctl snapshot --prefix "user:" --out /tmp/kv-snap.tgz`.

sarah: for immediate correctness guarantee, I'm enabling targeted KV bypass for prefixes matching `user:` and `session:` patterns and increasing TTL on the global cache to reduce evictions: `runtime.set --kv-bypass-pattern '^(user:|session:)' --kv-ttl 3600`. This will route affected traffic to authoritative storage instead of stale cache. Expect increased latency for those flows but correctness should improve. :warning:

mike: note — bypass will increase load on origin DB. I've added a short-term capacity bump on read replicas and an autoscale rule: `db:replica:scale --add 2 --duration 2h`. Watch CPU and tail latencies.

sarah: customer impact summary draft: ~12 tenants saw elevated 5xx, major customer ACME experienced incorrect completions in ~0.02% of their requests during the 14:02-14:18Z window. No PII exposure. Severity: high for correctness (targeted), overall platform availability degraded for affected prefixes.

jordan: I'm posting a proactive message to ACME support thread and scheduling a quick sync with their eng lead. Also prepping a public status note in case it widens.

eli: quick note on mitigations applied: 1) prefix-KV bypass for `user:`/`session:` 2) tenant rate-limits for top offenders 3) increased cache TTL 4) disabled streaming for the affected model variant to avoid partial-output hallucinations.

sarah: disabled streaming: `service/feature:disable --name streaming --model redwood-open-7b --env prod` — done. That reduced noise. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: UPDATE - mitigation in place: partial (traffic routed to fallback / bypass). Monitoring dashboards: https://dashboards.internal/cache-mismatch. Next steps: collect KV snapshot + cache metrics, plan rollback path, and ticket PM for postmortem.

mike: preparing handoff to night oncall at 00:00Z. I'll leave a short runbook in the incident ticket: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1938502468. Handoff: sarah -> devops-night (eli will be on-call first 2 hours).

sarah: leaving detailed notes in the ticket. Please keep reactions for any further changes. I'll hand off in 15m. Thanks everyone. :pray:

deploy-bot: ROLLING CHANGE complete to prod canaries for config `--kv-prefix-cache=disabled`.

eli: saving KV snapshot to S3 for postmortem: `s3://incidents/1938502468/kv-snapshot.tgz`.

mike: I'll run retention queries on affected request ids and produce a short SLA impact calc.

sarah: handoff complete — oncall: eli (first responder), mike (SRE), devops-night (backup). If we see re-escalation, ping #pager. Signing off until next check-in. :wave:
